Russia Will Soon Ban Peer-to-Peer Bitcoin Trading, Central Bank Confirms

items.title: Binance.US seeks $1B valuation in potential $100M funding round: Report
items.summary: The crypto exchange was reportedly looking to use the additional funding to regain market share following Binance’s 2023 settlement with US authorities.

items.title: At the White House, crypto policy vacancy looms large
items.summary: The departure of President Donald Trump's crypto adviser, Patrick Witt, leaves the digital assets office vacant and its policy aims uncertain.
